key_points: CEO commentary signals demand running past CAT's $72B backlog, reinforcing multi-quarter revenue visibility and the AI/data-center power thesis as a structural (not cyclical) demand driver.
CAT positioned as supplier of permanent power plants for data centers—not just backup—elevating its role in the AI infrastructure stack beyond traditional construction/mining exposure.
Multiple media outlets note hyperscaler capex as a sustained tailwind; street target ~$980 vs. current ~$808 implies ~20% upside if thesis plays out.
Bernstein maintains Hold rating, tempering enthusiasm—analyst consensus is not uniformly bullish despite positive narrative flow.
Most headlines are opinion/commentary rather than hard catalysts (no earnings beat, guidance raise, or M&A); impact is thesis-reinforcing rather than thesis-changing.
